notes: Two teams scoring on a marked pitch is Sports by the finish-condition split, and soccer is the Field Sport preset directly: touchlines a script can reset play from, a centre-circle kickoff position, goal-mouth scoring volumes, and painted pitch markings — the penalty area matters here because the referee and dive rules key off it. Shape is space-bounded, the rigid perimeter the genre's default, and the answers compress it to an arcade pitch inside a fully enclosed bowl, so I added barrier-perimeter and spectator-bleachers for the loud crowd the referee's crowd-pressure metric assumes. Bleachers are stepped relief with no overhang, so the build stays on P0 with tiered height captured. Everything else in the prompt — the referee scoring model, dive credibility, cards, replays, UI meters — is mechanics and UI with no layout footprint, so it does not add options or a second genre.
